description: This PHP script is part of the SuiteCRM system, specifically involved in rebuilding relationship metadata within the CRM database. It clears existing relationships, regenerates relationship definitions for all modules, and updates relationship caches, primarily during administrative maintenance or setup processes.

classes.name: SugarBean
classes.description: Base class for CRM beans, providing methods for relationship metadata management and object handling.

classes.name: Relationship
classes.description: Class managing relationship cache operations within the CRM system.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating CRM bean instances.

methods.name: createRelationshipMeta
methods.description: Creates or updates relationship metadata entries based on provided focus object and table information.

methods.name: delete_cache
methods.description: Deletes the cached relationship data to be rebuilt on demand.

methods.name: build_relationship_cache
methods.description: Rebuilds the relationship cache for the CRM system.
